entities.summary: Rasmus Rissanen is a Finnish professional ice hockey defenceman. He is currently under contract with Linköping HC in the Swedish Hockey League (SHL). Rissanen was selected by the Carolina Hurricanes in the 6th round of the 2009 NHL Entry Draft.
